claude_code.supported_min_source: the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json schema this catalog ships has been stable since 2.0.0; the previous floor was never validated
claude_code.verification_method: Real direct CLI check this run — `claude --version` on the runner reports `2.1.259 (Claude Code)`, the first live CLI available since 2.1.257, closing the changelog-only gap left after 2.1.258. `validated_against` and `latest_known` both advance to **2.1.259** together (no divergence this run). `claude plugin validate --strict --json .agents/skills` (piped through the new `scripts/report-skill-validation.py`) and a full `make validate` (regenerate + validate manifests, `make agent:check`; 3 plugins in sync, no drift) both passed clean against the live 2.1.259 CLI. Two 2.1.259 changelog items are directly relevant to this catalog, both checked directly rather than assumed. **`claude plugin validate --json` adopted.** The validator now accepts `--json` for a machine-readable report; `make validate-skills` now runs `--strict --json` and reports pass/fail via a small script, verified against both a clean run (`PASS`) and a deliberately broken scratch `SKILL.md` (`FAIL`, exit 1, correct warning surfaced). **Marketplace repo URL trailing-slash/dangling-`?`/`#` fix.** A `github.com` marketplace URL pasted with a trailing slash or dangling `?`/`#` (as a browser address bar shows it) could previously derive an unusable `.git` clone URL. This catalog's own install instructions always use the `Tamircohen28/tamirs-marketplace` shorthand (never affected), but the fix matters for anyone pasting this catalog's URL from a browser — documented as a new Troubleshooting row. Everything else in 2.1.259 (`managedMcpServers`, `--permission-prompts none`, `glab mr` recognition, the `~/.claude.json` concurrent-session-revert fix, the thinking-rejection-loop fix, the Remote Control Stop/background-agent fix, the workflow-resume duplicate-run fix, the blocking-Stop-hook cache-miss fix, the worktree Bash-loop/xargs fix, the `/workflows` JSON pretty-print, and the `allowedMcpServers`/`managed-mcp.json` scoping change) is host/session/UI-side or governs MCP-server/settings surfaces this catalog does not use — reviewed and found to have zero marketplace-manifest, plugin-source, or skill-loading impact. Prior 2.1.252→2.1.258 verification (the plugin symlink component-path rejection, MCP credential-log redaction, and the two 2.1.258 host-side bug fixes) still holds unchanged; see the install guide's per-version sections for that full history. Catalog install previously verified with `claude plugin marketplace add Tamircohen28/tamirs-marketplace` followed by `claude plugin install <name>@tamirs-marketplace`.

opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which `skills.paths` discovery of a catalog plugin's skills was verified with `opencode debug skill`
opencode.verification_method: opencode --version on the maintainer machine; latest from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai. OpenCode has no marketplace, so the catalog itself cannot be installed — each plugin repo is cloned and its skills verified with `opencode debug skill`

capability_gaps.marketplace: OpenCode has no plugin marketplace and no plugin manifest, so this catalog cannot be added as an install source. Each plugin repo is installed directly — clone it and point `skills.paths` at its `skills/` directory, or symlink it into the OpenCode skills directory. Every plugin in this catalog ships its own `opencode.json` and its own OpenCode install guide.
capability_gaps.catalog_discovery: There is no OpenCode equivalent of listing plugins from a remote catalog. The plugin table in this repo's README is the discovery surface; installation is then per-repo.
